title: List scheduled deployments
summary: List scheduled deployment plans. Archived plans are excluded.

response.name: data
response.description: Schedules with cron expression, status, and next_run_at.

title: Create scheduled deployment
summary: Create a cron schedule that starts a session for an agent.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent to deploy. `agent` is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: environment_id
parameters.description: Environment the scheduled session runs in.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Message payload passed to the scheduled session.

parameters.name: next_run_at
parameters.description: Override for the computed next run time.

response.name: paused_reason
response.description: Why the schedule is paused, or null when it is not. Currently always `{"type": "manual"}` when paused.

response.name: next_run_at
response.description: Computed next run time, or null when the cron expression has no future match.

title: Get scheduled deployment
summary: Retrieve a scheduled deployment plan. Archived plans are treated as missing.

response.name: paused_reason
response.description: Why the schedule is paused, or null when it is not.

title: Update scheduled deployment
summary: Update a scheduled deployment plan. Omitted fields keep their stored value.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Agent to deploy. `agent` is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: environment_id
parameters.description: Environment the scheduled session runs in.

parameters.name: next_run_at
parameters.description: Override for the next run time. An explicit null recomputes it from the cron expression.

response.name: cron
response.description: Stored cron expression after the update.

response.name: next_run_at
response.description: Next run time after the update.

title: Pause scheduled deployment
summary: Stop the schedule from producing timed runs. Sessions already running keep running, and a manual run is still allowed.

response.name: paused_reason
response.description: `{"type": "manual"}`. Tells an intentional pause apart from an automatic one.

title: Unpause scheduled deployment
summary: Resume the schedule from the next scheduled instant. Triggers missed while paused are not caught up.

response.name: paused_reason
response.description: Cleared, so a resumed schedule never reads as paused with a reason.

response.name: next_run_at
response.description: The next scheduled instant. Recomputed forward when the stored one had already passed.

title: Archive scheduled deployment
summary: Archive a scheduled deployment plan so it stops producing runs.

title: List schedule runs
summary: List run records for a schedule, including the session each run created.

title: Run scheduled deployment now
summary: Manually trigger a schedule and create a session. A paused schedule can still be run by hand; only an archived one is gone.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Overrides merged into the stored schedule payload for this run.

response.name: trigger_type
response.description: Trigger label recorded for this run.

title: Run due scheduled deployments
summary: Run every active schedule whose next_run_at has arrived.

response.name: data
response.description: Run records created by this pass.
